Observed at +0.8420419692993164s — page 3
114:- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): T
he sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person alrea
dy wrote — a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered
steps, tool calls, assertions), so the…
115:- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and dr
afts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `c
ompleted`.
116:- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-aut
horing-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or propo
sed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.
117:- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite
and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.
118:- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the sui
te. Past runs that executed it are not affected.
119:- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update — omitted fiel
ds are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks`
accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.
120:- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact refer
enced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then refer
ence. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.
121:- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.
md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: "FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED"` and `details.code: "SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED"`. `@
mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, whi
ch returns the `storageId` the run's results…
122:- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-
eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same
tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.
123:- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluation
s.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval i
ngestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.
124:- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one
-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses
by default.
125:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpj
am-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organiza
tion's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
126:- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK mod
el leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately — the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases al
so expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must
do.
127:- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run
complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.
128:- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): App
ends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.
129:- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-star
t.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login be
arer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, no
t completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…
130:- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.
md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs
/finalize`.
